# Vendored browser runtimes

`mermaid-11.17.2.min.js` is the unmodified browser bundle published by the
Mermaid project at:

`https://unpkg.com/mermaid@11.17.2/dist/mermaid.min.js`

SHA-256:

`581ed7d74bd9048d0e3a91363927d72ef22942d7722546b27f7cc29e35390eb8`

The local, versioned copy makes documentation rendering independent of a
third-party CDN at runtime. Update the version, source URL, checksum, and
`mkdocs.yml` reference together.
